ios.desc:
Stack Cash Back on top of coupons when you use the Rakuten app to get the best deal! It's 100% free for everyone - just join and start earning today!

Become one of the 17 million users who use Rakuten to get Cash Back

Shop 3,500+ stores all in one app

Here's how it works:
1. Join for free & choose a store to start shopping.
2. Earn Cash Back after you make a purchase.
3. Get paid via PayPal or check.
...and repeat!

REFER FRIENDS & EARN: Share your referral link with friends and earn when they make a purchase! They will earn too, it's a win-win! Referral bonuses are unlimited, and it's free to share. 

AUTOMATICALLY APPLY COUPONS: Rakuten will find and apply coupons at checkout. 

EARN IN STORE & WITH DINING: Activate free Cash Back offers near you to find the best restaurant and store deals in your area. 

MY ACCOUNT: Get detailed status on what your Cash Back status is. Know when your next payment date is, and choose how you get paid - either by check, gift card, or PayPal. 

Stack Cash Back with sales, coupons, free shipping, loyalty programs, and more! There's unlimited Cash Back every time you shop in the app.

We've paid our members over $3 billion to date. What are you waiting for?

*Based on TrustPilot reviews as of 03/2026

Stay in the loop for the latest ways to earn & save with Rakuten:

quotes.text:
Rakuten (Rakuten Rewards) | San Mateo, CA or San Francisco, CA | Some Remote | H-1B Transfer | Full Time | iOS Engineers, Android Engineers

Rakuten Rewards is looking for talented iOS and Android engineers to help solve challenging problems and reward our 15 million members with Cash Back. There are 2 squads currently hiring:

* Browse / Discovery - this is my squad and we're responsible for helping users discover new merchants on Rakuten and converting new members to making their first of many purchases

* Platform - this squad is responsible for building out the platform that other squads can build their features on such as the design system, headless CMS infrastructure, and everything in between. There are also new exciting features that are being planned but cannot be discussed here yet.

More on Rakuten:

Rakuten Rewards (previously known as Ebates) is a leading e-commerce company that enhances the way people shop by offering Cash Back, deals and rewards from more than 3,500 merchants. Founded in 1999, acquired by Rakuten in 2014, having paid out nearly $2 billion in Cash Back to its 15 million members. The company also operates ShopStyle, a leading fashion discovery destination, and Cartera Commerce, a top rewards platform for airlines and banks. For more information, visit www.rakuten.com.

Interested? Please reach out directly as not all of the positions have been posted yet - yuriy.dyrenko at rakuten.com
